summary: Complete reconstruction, mathematical engine build, and MS Excel verification of MDAR_Converter.xlsx
details: Completely reconstructed MDAR Excel as an engineering application: fixed xl/styles.xml by migrating to xlsxwriter with strictly numFmtId >= 164; designed 6 visible application sheets and 2 hidden engine sheets; rebuilt Transverse Mercator (Redfearn) forward and inverse equations for UTM and Egyptian grids; implemented Molodensky-Badekas (EPSG:7697) datum transformation; verified dynamic single-point recalculation; verified expandable batch table (ListObject); captured 6 real screenshots from MS Excel COM; verified lossless save/close/reopen with 0 errors.
